Each week is one completed Sunday–Saturday week of NIH award notice dates. An award appears once, in the week of its notice date, so amounts are never double-counted. NIH often posts an award, or its dollar amount, weeks late, so every Monday each week is checked again. A week is marked ✓ Complete after 8 weekly checks in a row find nothing new and no matching award still waiting for an amount; complete weeks are still checked once a month and reopen if anything turns up. Every award shows its Award Notice Date; awards that arrived after their week was first checked carry an amber Added: date tag. Cards with several awards list each one and end with a ruled = total. “No department listed” (-- in the table) means NIH reported none for that keyword-matched award. PI lines show the contact PI of the largest award. Emails tagged NIH were revealed on NIH’s own project page and saved in data/nih_emails.csv; emails tagged from a paper were found in the PI’s recent publications (PubMed and Europe PMC) and may belong to someone with a similar name. “View email on NIH” opens the PI’s NIH page at its View Email button; the Chrome email helper (needs the Tampermonkey extension) presses it once on the page you open and keeps a list to paste into data/nih_emails.csv. Source: NIH RePORTER (refreshes Sunday nights; this page updates every Monday morning).
